name: Calendar overlap checker
pitch: Lists all recurring meetings and flags any times that overlap.
instructions: Start by asking the calendar tool to list all recurring events. When the list is returned, read each event's title, start time, end time, and frequency. Build a comparison of every pair of events to check if their time slots overlap on the same day of the week. If an overlap is found, note both events and the conflicting time range. When no overlaps exist, tell the person clearly. When the calendar tool returns no recurring events, say so and stop. Show the person a summary table of all recurring meetings and any overlaps found.

examples.does: shows all repeated events from your calendar

readme:
# calendar overlap checker

Lists all recurring meetings on your calendar and flags any time overlaps. It needs read access to your calendar. It will not add, move, or delete any events.
